name: baseten-catalog-kimi
note: Catalog-backed counterpart to baseten-thinking, which uses a synthetic model. This model object is a VERBATIM copy of baseten/moonshotai/Kimi-K2.5 from the pi-ai catalog -- refreshed at the 0.86.1 regen, which added sendSessionAffinityHeaders (upstream 6671c6047) to every baseten model. It pins the chatTemplateArgs + supportsUsageInStreaming shape that real shipped models actually carry -- {"enable_thinking":{"$var":"thinking.enabled"}} -- rather than the richer synthetic shape. Backend is dist: unlike baseten-thinking (src, unreleased at the time), this data IS released so the published build arbitrates it. Refresh this model object whenever the catalog is regenerated.
